messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in model artifact fetch errors from Hugging Face registry. GET /models/* returning 429/503. Start 2026-03-15T11:05:12Z. Artifact fetch error rate ~47% over last 5m.

sara: Acknowledged. I see the prefetch workers all kicking off at once for new nodes, concurrent pulls look like the problem.

mike: Confirmed from logs. K8s autoscaler created a rash of pods and each triggered full-model pulls. HF started rate-limiting. Cold start failures for Dedicated pre-warms and Private prefetch jobs.

julian: Support report: two enterprise customers (acct:acme-inc, acct:veritas-ai) reported increased 502s. Traces show edge timeouts while waiting on model fetch.

ingrid: Is hosted API affected or only our reserved/private prefetch flows?

sara: Hosted API benefiting from our mirrors / variant fallbacks, so far okay. Dedicated and Private prefetch pipelines more impacted.

mike: Immediate mitigation checklist: 1) reduce prefetch concurrency 2) add backoff + jitter to artifact client 3) prefer smaller quantized variants on cold starts 4) enable mirrors where available 5) contact HF support and monitor their status page.

sara: Applying concurrency limit to prefetch controller: PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=3

sara: Command:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/prefetch-controller PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=3
```

ops-bot: Action created INC-2026-0321-29 assigned to sara, mike.

mike: Also reducing fetch rate from client side: set ARTIFACT_FETCH_BACKOFF_MS=250 and ARTIFACT_MAX_RETRIES=5 in runtime env for artifact-fetcher.

alex: I'll add randomized jitter 0-300ms and a small staggered startup delay to prefetch workers. Opening PR.

sara: Rollout applied, observed concurrent pull count drop ~60% within 90s. Artifact 429 rate down to ~10% after changes. Cold-start failure rate reduced significantly.

huggingface-status-bot: HF Status: "We are seeing elevated errors on model downloads and applying safeguards. Investigation ongoing." https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/ef12

julian: Customer impact summary for CSMs: two customers saw ~12% request failures during 11:05-11:25 UTC tied to model cold-starts. No data integrity issues, degraded availability only. Drafting note with mitigations and next steps.

ingrid: Please include our mitigations and estimated ETA (TBD until HF confirms). Consider SLA credit depending on postmortem.

mike: Added short-term routing change: prefer model-v2-8bit for cold starts to reduce download size. Patching pool routing rule.

sara: Route patch snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/route
{ "cold_start_priority": ["model-v2-8bit", "model-v2-32bit"] }
```

ops-bot: Mirroring job scheduled: enabling mirrors for region us-west-2 for affected Dedicated pools in 60s.

mike: Metrics check - artifact 429s dropped from 47% -> 7% after throttling + backoff; cold-start timeouts went from 4.2% -> 0.6% in last 3m.

sara: HF support acknowledged our ticket and noted they are lifting some tenant throttles for high-priority customers. They recommended using CDNs or mirrors for high-concurrency workflows.

julian: Sending interim customer note now: "We experienced intermittent model cold-start failures due to third-party artifact hosting rate-limits. Engineering applied mitigations (reduced prefetch concurrency, client backoff + jitter, fallback to smaller quantized variants, enabling mirrors). We are monitoring and coordinating with the third-party provider and will update when resolved."

ops-bot: Pager acknowledged by sara and mike. Incident will auto-handoff if unresolved >60m.

sara: Monitoring for regressions. If we see >5% artifact error rate again, escalate to incident commander.

mike: Creating a short dashboard for the incident (artifact 429/503 rate, pull concurrency, cold-start failure rate). Link: https://dashboards.redwood/INC-2026-0321-29

huggingface-status-bot: HF update: "Mitigation applied; reducing throttling for select tenants. No ETA."

sara: Current state: errors back to baseline, cold-start failures minimal. Putting incident in monitoring mode for 2 hours. Postmortem owner: mike, target write-up within 48h.

julian: Will follow up with affected CSMs after 20m if stable.

ingrid: Thanks all. Short updates only. Escalate immediately if errors spike above threshold.

nora: :thumbsup: Nice quick TTR. Let's add infra work to reduce blast radius of large concurrent pulls (prefetch spread, mirrors by default).

sara: Signing off from active pager. Leave monitoring on; ping if it resurfaces.

ops-bot: Incident status -> monitoring. INC-2026-0321-29
